name: Creamy Fish Pie with Cheddar Mash
method: Boil the potatoes until soft and mash with half the cheddar and a splash of the milk.
Poach the cod in the rest of the milk for 5 minutes, lift out and flake. Whisk the cornflour and butter into the milk to thicken it into a sauce.
Stir the prawns, peas and flaked cod into the sauce, spoon into a dish, top with the mash and remaining cheddar and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
